m4_merge_kb — 相似知识点合并测试夹具
=====================================

用于 `suggest_kp_merge` 与后续 semantic merge 开发/回归。

场景 ID          | 锚点 KP id        | 期望 suggest 包含        | 期望不包含
-----------------|-------------------|--------------------------|------------------
same-name-cross  | rl-intro-a        | rl-intro-b               | unrelated-cook
name-typo-pair   | attn-mechanism    | attn-mech-typo           | unrelated-cook
name-variant     | policy-grad       | policy-grad-full         | unrelated-cook
tag-bridge-only  | ddpg-algo         | (无，仅 tag 相同)        | dqn-discrete
en-zh-pair       | attention-en      | (无，Lexical 当前)       | yizhu-jizhi
id-prefix-only   | mdp-core          | (通常无)                 | mdp-intro
unrelated-control| rl-intro-a        | —                        | unrelated-cook

说明：
- 当前 merge 仅按 **name** 走 Lexical search，tag/跨语言需 Embedding 后续增强。
- 运行：pytest tests/unit/services/test_kp_merge_scenarios.py -q
